Hi Maria — thanks for the note and great questions. I've put together a short procurement checklist and attached it (procurement_checklist.xlsx). Summary below and next steps at the bottom.

Procurement checklist (high-level)
- Standard commercial SOW (signed) — includes SLAs and support window
- SOC 2 report + summary of data residency options (we provide SOC2 Type II and can point to recent pen test)
- Billing SKU mapping (GCP SKUs vs Redwood internal sku names)
- Contracting schedule and preferred payment terms (we can accept PO + Net30 / ACH)
- Contact list for technical and billing questions (we'll provide a single point of contact)

Listing enablement timeline (typical)
- Doc prep & PO acceptance: 1–3 business days after final SOW/PO received
- Billing/SKU mapping and GCP registration: 2–5 business days (depends on GCP approvals)
- Dedicated capacity provisioning / private listing enablement: 5–10 business days after registration is live (capacity lead time varies by region)

Action items (proposed)
- I will attach our SOW template and a draft SKU mapping (Lauren will follow with SOW PDF).
- Ben will scope capacity lead time for us in us-west1 and give a firm date.
- Maria, if you can share your procurement lead's email I will send the DocuSign-ready packet and a one-page summary.

Thanks — Hannah
